text:
maya: flagging a live customer hit: sampleapp stream crashes when behind corporate proxy on Win+Chrome. stack points at TextDecoder.decode on chunk boundary.
eli: ugh. any raw captures?
maya: pasted trimmed server capture: 
```
2026-03-22T10:11:01.001Z OUT chunk="data: {\"id\":10,\"text\":\"Hi \"}\n"
2026-03-22T10:11:01.002Z OUT chunk="data: {\"id\":10,\"text\":\"\xF0\x9F\x98\"}\n"
2026-03-22T10:11:01.003Z OUT chunk="data: {\"id\":10,\"text\":\"\x8A\"}\n"
```
maya: proxy split a multi-byte emoji across reads. sampleapp decodes per-read without streaming mode so decoder throws on invalid start byte. also noticed extra blank line chunks between events from proxy gzip boundary, so parser emits empty events and duplicates partial payloads.
sam: does node/browser differ?
maya: yes — node sdk was buffering bytes and avoided this; browser fetch path decoded each chunk. parity gap.
el i: fix plan: 1) switch to TextDecoder.decode(chunk, {stream:true}) and keep leftover bytes in an internal Uint8Array; 2) treat empty events (blank lines) as no-ops; 3) detect server comment markers like ":resume <token>" and reset parser state on them to avoid merging pre-reauth leftovers.
jonah: also observed auth-refresh races: when the client reconnects, some implementations merge leftover bytes from previous conn into new stream without reset, producing concatenated JSON objects like `..."lo"}{"id":2...` which crashes JSON.parse. reset on resume/comment sounds good.
sam: i'll PR a tiny sse parser util for both sdk/browser paths. api: createSseParser({onEvent, onComment}) with methods feed(chunk) and reset(). implement streaming TextDecoder, a small balanced-brace heuristic for JSON frame completion, and drop empty events.
eli: add unit e2e that runs a proxy-mock that injects CRLFs at random, splits utf8 codepoints mid-sequence, and inserts comment lines. run across win/chrome and node matrix.
ci-bot: sampleapp-integration/stream-reassembly-win-proxy queued; 3 tests will run.
devx-bot: created RDW-1971: "sampleapp: streaming parser resilient to proxy CRLF, utf8 splits, and auth-retry reassembly" assigned to sam + eli.
maya: customer has a temporary workaround (disable proxy compression) but wants upstream fix. I'll send them the issue and ETA.
sam: will open PR today with parser util, tests, and a docs blurb for readme. aiming for small, low-risk changes. :thumbsup:
